content: Lokiya vaita lagesa afita fatago nehuna vayaꞌmogitamo lagaitiekeꞌmo lagesa neꞌafita lahauꞌnisiya kavaꞌmo osuta lokiya noꞌvaiya vayaꞌmogimo afiꞌa ha leꞌa noꞌafiya kavateꞌmo vase vase huta hapa maesuna kavaꞌmo haneꞌniye.
Lagaemo lamete lamete huta konagatimogi apamogaga aiꞌa alagepa huꞌa maisayafeꞌmo hapa maeta alita lokiya vaita apatesuna kavakeꞌmo haneꞌniye.

Kalaisiꞌa agaiꞌaekeꞌmo agesa neꞌafino agaiꞌa hauꞌniya kavaꞌmo osuꞌniyaꞌmonanafa agaemo huꞌniya kavatefeꞌmo Goti mukufi gemoꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Huꞌa faipa huꞌa kateꞌnaya gemo nagaeteꞌmo asagauno aiꞌniye, huno huꞌniye.

Akeyaꞌvilagamo avo kae maleꞌnaya gemoꞌmo alino laya malesiyafeꞌmo avo kae maleꞌnae. Goti mukufiꞌmo huꞌniya gemoꞌa laha maesigeta oꞌataleta atafauta alagi huta maiꞌnisunageno laipamoꞌmo falu huꞌnisigeta lavayagunagu huta agava maisunafeꞌmo avo kae maleꞌnae.

Gotiꞌa oꞌataleta atafauta alagi huta maiꞌnisunagenoꞌaeꞌmo laipamoꞌmo falu hisiya kavaꞌmo aepa vekamoꞌa lapaipafiꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo alisigetapa Kalaisi Yesuꞌa huꞌniya geleꞌe kavateꞌefeꞌmo alagepa hutapa lapakesa afitetapa magokepi lokaeta maiyo.
Magoke lapaipa lapakesa aliꞌnetapa magoke lapavayafatiꞌmo Ala kava netimo Yesu Kalaisi Gotiꞌamo Afoꞌamo agiꞌaleꞌmo alita asaga hutapa atesayafeꞌmae.
Inagi Gotiꞌa ala agiꞌamo alisiyafeꞌmo Kalaisiꞌa ago lapavaleꞌniya kava hutapa lapakaemo muki konagatapimogimo apavaleyo.

Nagaemo huꞌnaeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa Yu vayaꞌmogita laginago vayaꞌaifeꞌmo fiku lapa maegauve, huno hapa paiꞌniya polomasi geꞌamo afole aisiyafeꞌmo Kalaisiꞌa Goti aliꞌyaꞌaleꞌmo maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo Yu vayaꞌaitegamo uno aliꞌyaꞌamo aliꞌniye.
Ani kava huno alu nofi vayaꞌaifeꞌmo Gotiꞌa hau huno apateꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo agiꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga huꞌa atesayafeꞌmo uno aliꞌyaꞌamo aliꞌniye. Goti mukufi gemoꞌa ani kavatefeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Alu nofi vayaꞌai folagapiꞌmo maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo kagikaleꞌmo aliꞌna asaga huꞌna kateteꞌna kagikalefeꞌmo mono yokemo huguve,

content: huno huꞌniye.
Magoꞌe gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Alu nofi vayaꞌmogitapae, Goti vayaꞌamogiꞌeꞌmo magokepi lapamogaga aiyo,

content: huno huꞌniye.
Magoꞌe gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Muki alu nofi vayaꞌmogitapae, Ala kava neꞌmo agiꞌaleꞌmo alitapa asaga hiyo. Muki alu nofi vayaꞌe alu nofi vayaꞌmogiꞌeꞌmo agiꞌaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga hiyo,

content: huno huꞌniye.
Aiyeyaꞌa magoꞌe gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Yesi aginago vayaꞌmogimo mago yosamo heꞌya aiꞌa ataleꞌnaya yosagana huꞌa maiꞌnae. Maiꞌnayaꞌmonanafa magoke aginagomoꞌa alu nofi vayaꞌaiteꞌe alu nofi vayaꞌaiteꞌeꞌmo yagaino apatesiyafeꞌmo yosa atufaꞌafatiꞌmo ausisi aesigeꞌapaeꞌmo alu nofi vayaꞌmogimo agaefeꞌmo apavayagunagu huꞌa agava maigae,

content: huno huꞌniye.

Hemenimo Gotifeꞌmo lapavayagunagu hutapa agava neꞌmaiya kavaꞌmo aepa vekamoꞌa magoꞌe huno lapa maeno lapamisigetapa agaefeꞌmo lapakesa afita fatago nehutapaeꞌmo magoꞌe hutapa lapamogaga aisageno lapaipamoꞌmo falu hugiyanagi. Aote Aunemeꞌamo himamuꞌaletiꞌmo magoꞌe hutapa lapavayagunagu hutapa agava maisayafeꞌmae.
Poloꞌa aliꞌyaꞌamo aliꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌniya gemae
Konagaꞌnimogitapae, huꞌna, alagepa kavaꞌe afiꞌnaya geꞌeꞌmo lapaipa lapakesafiꞌmo havai teꞌniyanagetapa afaꞌa alita apaya malegae, huꞌna lole nagesa noꞌafufa magoke nagesa neꞌafuve.
Nagesa neꞌafuvaꞌmonanafa konagaꞌnimogitapae, Gotiꞌa fiku naha maeno namiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo mago kavafeꞌmo lapakesa afitapa ho hisayafeꞌmo huꞌna ha leꞌna avo nekaove.

Mono huꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌmogimo Gotiꞌmo ofalinimo neꞌamiya kava huꞌna alagepa faigoko geꞌaletiꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaliꞌnaeꞌmo alu nofi vayaꞌmo apavaleliꞌna eꞌna ani ofalinimo aliꞌna Gotiꞌmo amigesuve. Aote Aunemeꞌamoꞌmo apavaleno alino apaote apatesigeꞌa alagepa ofalinieꞌmo Gotiꞌa amuse huno atesiya agufa ofalini yakana huꞌa maisageꞌna aliꞌna amiguve.
Mani aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌaluvaꞌmofeꞌmo Goti aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaluva kavatefeꞌmo Kalaisi Yesuꞌa naha maeꞌniya kavatetiꞌmo afaꞌa hao ke hegauve.
Kalaisiꞌa ayamufa huno nateꞌnigeꞌna alu nofi vayaꞌmogi Goti geꞌamo afiteꞌa akame hisayafeꞌmo ge huge lokiya kavaꞌmo huge nehuꞌna aiꞌna apavayu huliꞌna neꞌova kavafekeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌna lapa paiguve.

Nagaemo Goti Aunemeꞌamo himamuꞌaletiꞌmo noꞌagaya lokiya aune kavaꞌmo nehuꞌnaeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo aliꞌnove. Nagaemo Kalaisifeꞌmo alagepa faigoko geꞌamo aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna hapa pailiꞌna uꞌneꞌna huliꞌna Yulusalemu haopalegatiꞌmo eꞌna muki Ililikamu kotega haopalegamo uꞌna hapa paiꞌna hano huꞌnove.

Nagaemo muki afinaꞌmo Kalaisifeꞌmo alagepa faigoko geꞌamo aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa opaiꞌnaya vayaꞌaitegaꞌeꞌmo uꞌna aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna hapa paisuvafeꞌmo nayamukiki huꞌnove. Mago vayaꞌmogi noꞌmo faiꞌa ateꞌnisaya yateꞌmo no kisuvafeꞌmo oꞌnahauꞌniye.
Ani kavatefeꞌmo Gotiꞌa avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniya gemoꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Ava gemo oꞌafiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi agegae. Oꞌafiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogi afiꞌa aeto hugae,

content: huno huꞌniye.
Poloꞌa Lomu taonifiꞌmo ugesuve, huno huꞌniya gemae
Alu afinaꞌae alu afinaꞌaeꞌmo lapakaetegamo ugefeꞌmo nehuvaꞌmonanafa oꞌafiꞌnaya vayaꞌaitegaꞌe vayaꞌaitegaꞌeꞌmo uꞌneꞌna huꞌna aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna hapa nepauvaꞌmofeꞌmo visuva kaꞌnimo alagi ohaneꞌniye.

Ohaneꞌniyaꞌmonanafa hemenimo manileꞌmo aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna hapa paisuva koꞌmo ohaneꞌnigeꞌna muki kafugaꞌaeꞌmo uꞌna lapakegefeꞌmo nehuvaꞌmofeꞌmo Sipeni kotega visuva afinaꞌmo uꞌna lapakegauve. Uꞌnaeꞌmo hogoteꞌna lapakaeꞌeꞌmo mago afinaꞌmo maiꞌneꞌna namogaga aiguve. Amuse hutapa natetesageꞌnaeꞌmo Sipeni kotegamo uguve, huꞌna nagesa neꞌafiꞌna navayagunagu nehuve.
Hemenimo Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya apaote vayaꞌmo hapa maeꞌna apamisuva ofalini monimo aliniꞌna Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo visuvafeꞌmo nehuve.

Masetoniya kotega siosi vayanagi Akaiya kotega siosi vayanagi huꞌa Yulusalemu taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya apaote vayaꞌmo kagemi yaꞌapimo ohaneꞌniya vayaꞌmo hapa maeꞌa apamisayafeꞌmo hapauꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo mago ofalini monimo namiꞌnae.

Apakaiꞌapimo hapauꞌniyaꞌmonanafa Yu vayaꞌmogi hapa maeꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo Yu vayaꞌmo hapa maesaya anonaꞌapimo haneꞌniye. Yu vayaꞌmogimo apauneꞌapameꞌmo hapa maesiya yaꞌmo ago hapa maeꞌa aliꞌa apamiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo apakaemo Yu vayaꞌmo amega apakufamo hapa maesigeno alagepa huno hanesiya yaꞌmo aliꞌa apamisaya anonaꞌapimo haneꞌniye.
Nagaemo mani muki maleꞌnaya ofalini monimoꞌa alagagana huno afole aiꞌniya ofalini monimo aliniꞌna uꞌna apamiteꞌnaeꞌmo Sipeni kotega visuvategamo uꞌna lapakaeꞌeꞌmo maiguve.
Ago afiꞌnovana uꞌna avaꞌyi huteꞌna Kalaisifeꞌmo alagepa faigoko geꞌaletiꞌmo lapa maeꞌna magoꞌe yaꞌmo aliꞌna lapamiguve.

Konagaꞌnimogitapae, Lapao ke hovanagi, Ala kava netimo Yesu Kalaisifeꞌmo lapau lapayamopafiꞌmo lapauꞌnisigetapa Goti Aunemeꞌamoꞌmo lapaipafiꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo aliꞌnigetapa Goti mafaꞌneꞌaeꞌmo lapau lapayamopafiꞌmo nelapaiyaꞌmofeꞌmo lapayamukiki hutapa naha maeta nunumuꞌmo hutapa nateyo.

Gotiꞌa Yuta kotega apakesa afiꞌa fatago osuꞌnaya vayaꞌai apayapatiꞌmo nagufamo alino katino natesiyafeꞌmo nunumuꞌmo hutapa natege Yulusalemu taonifi apaote vayaꞌmo hapa maesugeꞌapaeꞌmo amuse hisayafeꞌmo nunumuꞌmo hutapa natege hutapa maiyo.
Lapakaemo nunumu hisagenoꞌaeꞌmo Gotiꞌa hauꞌnisiyana lapakaetegamo uꞌna avaꞌyi huteꞌna lusi kava huꞌna namogaga neꞌaiꞌna lapakaeꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeꞌna maiꞌneꞌnaeꞌmo naipamoꞌmo falu hugiye.
Gotiꞌa alagepa huta neꞌmauna yaꞌmo aepa vekamoꞌa mukiꞌamogitapaꞌeꞌmo magokepi lokaeno maino. He. Lama ge.
